Definition: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity:--equal(-ity).
BiblicalUsage: Equality is the fairness Paul asks the churches to practise. In 2 Corinthians 8:13 he says, I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened, but by an equality, in 2 Corinthians 8:14 your abundance may be a supply for their want, that there may be equality, and in Colossians 4:1 masters are told to give unto their servants that which is just and equal.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that equality in Paul's mouth is not sameness of purse but fairness of heart: abundance supplies want. The master treats the servant as the Lord treats him.
